images.filename: StateLibQld 2 202091 Official opening of the Hughenden to Richmond railway line, 1904.jpg
images.caption:
Official opening of the Hughenden to Richmond railway line, 1904.
The official opening of the Richmond extension. The excursion train at the station. [Caption on photograph] Construction west from Hughenden, 114 kilometres to Richmond, began in July 1902. The line opened through to Richmond on the 1st June 1904. [Information taken from John Kerr, Triumph of narrow gauge: a history of Queensland Railways, 1990] Original photographer: Mr Williams, Winton.
images.alt:
Official opening of the Hughenden to Richmond railway line, 1904.
The official opening of the Richmond extension. The excursion train at the station. [Caption on photograph] Construction west from Hughenden, 114 kilometres to Richmond, began in July 1902. The line opened through to Richmond on the 1st June 1904.
